Generated bank transaction and error counter metrics metadata.

# Purpose
This file defines the `FD_METRICS_BANK` table, which lists the bank metrics used by the system. It is generated by `gen_metrics.py`, so it must not be edited by hand. The table contains counter metrics for bank transaction failures, processing results, and transaction outcome codes, including the `BANK_TRANSACTION_RESULT` and `BANK_TRANSACTION_LOAD_ADDRESS_TABLES` groups with their enum values. Each entry uses `DECLARE_METRIC` or `DECLARE_METRIC_ENUM` to map a metric name to its type and, when needed, to a specific result value.
